run_valids_find_best: run valids.py on a log directory to find the best validation loss across experiments
run_valids_group_on: run valids.py with --group_on to compare results grouped by a specific hyperparameter
run_valids_compact: run valids.py with --compact to print checkpoint names and best values in tab-separated format
run_valids_extract_params: run valids.py with --hydra to extract and parse hydra-style parameters from experiment paths
run_valids_best_only: run valids.py with --best_only to print only the single best metric value found
